# MCP Tools

<!-- This file is @generated by `cargo run -- generate-docs`. -->

This document describes the public MCP tool contract exposed by
`obsidian-vault-mcp`. All paths are vault-relative unless stated otherwise. The
server supports structural section edits as well as read operations.

## Tool Index

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `append_section` | Append content at the end of exactly one heading or block section. This uses structural selection, not text matching. |
| `apply_patch` | Apply a unified diff to existing Markdown notes after validating every hunk and preserved reference. Preview is the default. |
| `audit_links` | Audit unresolved and ambiguous local links across the visible vault. |
| `create_note` | Create a new Markdown note at an exact vault-relative .md path without overwriting an existing file. |
| `delete_note` | Delete a visible Markdown note with no inbound references from visible notes. Preview is the default; set dry_run to false to apply. |
| `delete_section` | Delete exactly one heading or block section. Refuse edits that break existing heading or block links. |
| `edit_history` | Show undoable and redoable edits in this server process, newest first, with command, time, and affected files. |
| `edit_note` | Replace exact text in one Markdown note. By default the text must occur exactly once; set replace_all to replace every occurrence. Refuse edits that break preserved links or embeds. Preview is the default. |
| `get_backlinks` | Get backlinks to a uniquely resolved note, heading, or block. Optional include and exclude filter source-note paths; excludes take precedence. |
| `get_category` | Locate one folder-derived category in visible notes. Optional include and exclude use vault-relative glob patterns; include patterns are unioned, empty arrays do not restrict, and excludes take precedence. |
| `get_note_neighborhood` | Return a bounded resolved-link neighborhood around one note reference. |
| `get_note_outline` | Return one note's selectable non-H1 headings as a flat paged list without body text; use before read_note. |
| `get_note_stats` | Return one note or bare heading/block reference's word, character, and line counts |
| `get_note_structure` | Summarize one note: headings, tags, embeds, block IDs, frontmatter field names, and link count. Use get_outlinks for link targets. |
| `get_outlinks` | Get outgoing local links from one note as compact resolved, ambiguous, and unresolved target groups |
| `get_tag` | Locate one tag in visible notes. Optional include and exclude use vault-relative glob patterns; include patterns are unioned, empty arrays do not restrict, and excludes take precedence. |
| `list_categories` | List folder-derived categories from visible notes. Optional include and exclude use vault-relative glob patterns; include patterns are unioned, empty arrays do not restrict, and excludes take precedence. |
| `list_files` | Discover visible files, including .base, .canvas and attachments, without parsing their contents. Filter by extensions and relative-path globs. Discovery obeys vault ignores; list_notes remains Markdown-only. Files per page defaults to 100, maximum 100. |
| `list_notes` | Page through visible Markdown notes for lightweight navigation. Set limit between 1 and 100 to keep responses compact; it defaults to 100. |
| `list_tags` | List unique tag names across visible notes. Optional include and exclude use vault-relative glob patterns; include patterns are unioned, empty arrays do not restrict, and excludes take precedence. |
| `query_base_views` | List a .base file's configured views in file order without executing formulas, filters, queries or plugin views. Names remain exact, null or duplicated; read_base's optional view requires an exact unique name and otherwise defaults to the first view. |
| `query_frontmatter` | Query notes by a top-level frontmatter field using explicit exists, equals, or regex mode |
| `read_attachment` | Read a project-relative PDF, DOCX, PNG, or JPEG attachment. PDFs use native text extraction first and identify pages that need optional local OCR; PNG and JPEG use that same ocr-local runtime. |
| `read_base` | Execute one local Obsidian .base view and return its actual rows, formulas, filters, sorting, groups, limit and summaries as Markdown. Use query_base_views first to discover names; view selects an exact unique name, or omit it for the first view. context_note supplies the embedding/active file for this. Unknown syntax or functions fail explicitly. Return path, view, view_type, output_format=markdown, content and pagination {page,total_pages}; every Markdown data row includes its full vault-relative path, and resolved links use full readable paths. Pagination uses complete rows; summaries cover all result rows after limit, before pagination. If page is less than total_pages, request page+1 with the same max_chars. |
| `read_canvas` | Read an exact .canvas file as complete Mermaid for LLM understanding: full text, typed file/image references with subpaths, URLs, arrows, labels and inferred group membership. Each page is a valid flowchart with complete edge endpoint context; a complete unit may exceed max_chars. Reuse the same max_chars on subsequent pages. Return path, output_format=mermaid, content and pagination {page,total_pages}; group-inference diagnostics stay in Mermaid comments. No source-line references are fabricated. |
| `read_note` | Read raw Markdown from a note or section. Prefer get_note_outline to choose a heading or line range. Use either a reference fragment or one explicit selector (heading, block_id, line); omit both for the whole note. |
| `redo_edit` | Redo the latest undone edit or requested number of steps in this server process. The whole request is rejected on conflict. |
| `rename_heading` | Rename one heading and update uniquely resolved Obsidian wikilinks to it. Set dry_run to false to apply; preview is the default. |
| `rename_note` | Move a note to a new vault-relative path and update uniquely resolved wikilinks. Set dry_run to false to apply. |
| `replace_section` | Replace a heading section's body while preserving its heading, or replace a block. Refuse edits that break existing heading or block links. |
| `resolve_ref` | Resolve an Obsidian reference such as [[Note#Heading]] to a note, heading, or block without guessing ambiguous targets |
| `search_regex` | Search visible Markdown notes with a Rust regular expression. Optional include and exclude use vault-relative glob patterns; include patterns are unioned, empty arrays do not restrict, and excludes take precedence. |
| `search_text` | Search visible Markdown notes with literal text. Optional include and exclude use vault-relative glob patterns; include patterns are unioned, empty arrays do not restrict, and excludes take precedence. |
| `set_block_id` | Set, generate, replace, or delete one lowercase block id. Select by existing id or unique block content. Replacements update resolved wikilinks; deletion is refused while references exist. Set dry_run to false to apply. |
| `set_frontmatter_field` | Set one literal top-level frontmatter field in an exact existing .md note using a required JSON value. Null sets YAML null, never deletes. Defaults to dry_run=true. Preserve body, BOM, line endings and other fields with their comments; the replaced value may lose internal formatting/comments; reject malformed/duplicate YAML and edits that break references or affect other metadata. Applied changes support edit history, undo and redo; no-ops create no history. |
| `undo_edit` | Undo the latest edit or requested number of steps in this server process. The whole request is rejected on conflict. |

## 🔧 `append_section`

Append content at the end of exactly one heading or block section. This uses structural selection, not text matching.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `string` | yes | Workspace-relative path, note stem, or alias. |
| `heading` | `string \| null` | no | Heading text, heading anchor, or slash-separated heading path. |
| `block_id` | `string \| null` | no | Block id without the leading caret. |
| `content` | `string` | yes | Text appended at the selected section boundary. |


Output:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changed` | `string` | yes | Vault-relative path of the note that was changed. |


## 🔧 `apply_patch`

Apply a unified diff to existing Markdown notes after validating every hunk and preserved reference. Preview is the default.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `patch` | `string` | yes | Unified diff with --- a/path.md and +++ b/path.md headers and one or more hunks. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | no | Preview all changed notes without writing. Defaults to true. |


Output:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changed_notes` | `string[]` | yes | Vault-relative paths that would change or were changed. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | yes | Whether changes were only previewed. |

## 🔧 `edit_note`

Replace exact text in one Markdown note. By default the text must occur exactly once; set replace_all to replace every occurrence. Refuse edits that break preserved links or embeds. Preview is the default.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Existing vault-relative Markdown path ending in .md. |
| `old_text` | `string` | yes | Nonempty text that must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true. |
| `new_text` | `string` | yes | Text to put in its place. |
| `replace_all` | `boolean` | no | Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match. Defaults to false. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | no | Preview without writing. Defaults to true. |


Output:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Vault-relative path of the edited note. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | yes | Whether changes were only previewed. |

## 🔧 `read_base`

Execute one local Obsidian .base view and return its actual rows, formulas, filters, sorting, groups, limit and summaries as Markdown. Use query_base_views first to discover names; view selects an exact unique name, or omit it for the first view. context_note supplies the embedding/active file for this. Unknown syntax or functions fail explicitly. Return path, view, view_type, output_format=markdown, content and pagination {page,total_pages}; every Markdown data row includes its full vault-relative path, and resolved links use full readable paths. Pagination uses complete rows; summaries cover all result rows after limit, before pagination. If page is less than total_pages, request page+1 with the same max_chars.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Exact vault-relative .base path. Rendered output never uses source-line references. |
| `view` | `string \| null` | no | Exact unique view name from query_base_views; omit to use the first view in file order. |
| `context_note` | `string \| null` | no | Exact embedding/active file path for this; defaults to the .base itself. |
| `page` | `integer` | no |  |
| `max_chars` | `integer \| null` | no | Unicode-character page budget. Complete rows plus headers and summaries may exceed it. |


Output:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes |  |
| `view` | `string` | yes |  |
| `view_type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `output_format` | `string` | yes | Always markdown. Supported layouts share a semantic Markdown table. |
| `content` | `string` | yes | Markdown with the selected view and a complete source path in every data row. |
| `pagination` | `RenderPagination` | yes | Compare page with total_pages to determine whether another page follows. |

Nested types:

### `RenderPagination`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `integer` | yes |  |
| `total_pages` | `integer` | yes |  |

Return path, output_format=mermaid, content and pagination {page,total_pages}; group-inference diagnostics stay in Mermaid comments. No source-line references are fabricated.

| `output_format` | `string` | yes | Always mermaid. Every page is a complete flowchart, without Markdown fences. |
| `content` | `string` | yes |  |
| `pagination` | `RenderPagination` | yes |  |

Nested types:

| `page` | `integer` | yes |  |

## 🔧 `read_note`

Read raw Markdown from a note or section. Prefer get_note_outline to choose a heading or line range. Use either a reference fragment or one explicit selector (heading, block_id, line); omit both for the whole note.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `string` | yes | Relative path, stem, alias, or reference: Note#Heading, Note#^id, Note#L1-L20. |
| `max_chars` | `integer \| null` | no | Unicode-character budget; the complete boundary line is returned even if it exceeds this value. |
| `heading` | `string \| null` | no | Heading text, anchor, or slash-separated path; H1 and Markdown heading syntax are accepted. |
| `block_id` | `string \| null` | no | Block id without the leading caret. |
| `line` | `string \| null` | no | Line or inclusive range, e.g. L3 or L3-L20. |


Output:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Selected source range before truncation, e.g. note.md#L3-L20. |
| `content` | `string` | yes |  |
| `truncated` | `boolean \| null` | no | True when selected content remains unread; omitted otherwise. |
| `returned_source` | `string \| null` | no | Actual returned source range when truncated. |
| `next_line` | `integer \| null` | no | Next unread line when truncated; resume with note#L{next_line}-. |

## 🔧 `set_frontmatter_field`

Set one literal top-level frontmatter field in an exact existing .md note using a required JSON value. Null sets YAML null, never deletes. Defaults to dry_run=true. Preserve body, BOM, line endings and other fields with their comments; the replaced value may lose internal formatting/comments; reject malformed/duplicate YAML and edits that break references or affect other metadata. Applied changes support edit history, undo and redo; no-ops create no history.

Input:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `string` | yes | Exact workspace-relative existing .md path; not a stem, alias or selector. |
| `field` | `string` | yes | Literal top-level YAML key. Dots are part of the key, not a nested path. |
| `value` | `unknown` | yes | Required JSON value. Null sets YAML null; it does not delete the field. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | no | Preview without writing. Defaults to true. |


Output:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Exact workspace-relative Markdown path. |
| `field` | `string` | yes | Literal top-level key, including dots if supplied. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | yes |  |
| `changed` | `boolean` | yes | Whether the field would change or was changed. No-op edits create no history. |
| `previous_exists` | `boolean` | yes | Distinguishes an absent field from an existing YAML null. |
| `previous_value` | `unknown` | yes | Previous JSON-compatible value; null when the field was absent. |
| `result_value` | `unknown` | yes | Proposed/resulting JSON value. Null sets YAML null and never deletes the key. |
